# Multivariate latent-input model

This reusable engine handles a multivariate latent state measured through
multiple noisy ordinal proxies, together with multivariate numeric predictors.
Study II is one configured use of this model; the posterior, prediction, and
diagnostic code is available to general package users.

```{r copy-study2-engine, include=FALSE}
repository_dir <- dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE))
source_file <- file.path(
  repository_dir, "script", "newly-written-and-modified-scripts",
  "model_multivariate.R"
)
target_file <- file.path(usethis::proj_get(), "R", basename(source_file))
stopifnot(file.copy(source_file, target_file, overwrite = TRUE))
stopifnot(identical(
  unname(tools::md5sum(source_file)), unname(tools::md5sum(target_file))
))
```
